name: reasoning-workflow
title_zh: 先问「真问题是什么」再开工的深度研究总控
tagline_zh: 接到任务别急着搜。它先帮你拆出问题模型、校准深度、推因果链，再决定要哪些证据、调哪些工具，直到根问题真解决才收工。
tagline_en: Don't rush to search. It first maps the problem, calibrates depth, traces causal chains, then routes tools—and.
desc_en: General-purpose governing workflow for substantive AI-agent work. Use it to understand the real task, calibrate useful depth, build and revise problem models, reason about relationships and causal chains, derive evidence needs, route specialist capabilities progressively, execute controlled work, verify outcomes, and close only when the root task is genuinely resolved.
why_zh: 多数 Agent 死于「答非所问」或「浅尝辄止」。它把「理解任务—建模—推因果—定证据—分派—验证—收…
why_en: Most agents die from answering the wrong question or stopping too shallow. This forces reasoning before retrieval—modeling.
limit_zh: 它是总控流程而非具体工具，不内置搜索/代码/绘图能力，需配合已装好的子技能使用；对一句话就能答完的简单任务。
limit_en: A governing workflow, not a tool—no built-in search/code/plot. Requires existing sub-skills. Overkill for trivial one-liner tasks.
title_en: Deep-research workflow that first pins down the real.
